autogen.note: Autogen item: the XML holds only the formula ranges (data/items.json autogen.abilities); the game scales damage or armour with the item level, so the base numbers are not in the files

notes.required_level: not in the equipment XML (computed by game scripts): null
notes.set_bonuses: not in the XML (the pieces are only tagged); sets[*].bonuses is null
notes.stat_values: min/max are the raw XML numbers; type is the game's: base, add, mult. Percentages are fractions (0.1 = 10%). A max means the value is rolled between min and max
